subject: 2026 Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony
query: when will the rock and roll hall of fame 2026 ceremony air
title: When will the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame 2026 ceremony air? Dec. 8 on ABC
answer: Not live. The 2026 Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony is taped Saturday, Nov. 14, 2026, at the Peacock Theater in Los Angeles. An edited three-hour special airs Tuesday, Dec. 8, from 8 to 11 p.m. ET/PT on ABC, and it streams on Disney+ and Hulu starting the next day, Dec. 9.
body:
So if you are looking for a livestream on Nov. 14, there isn't one from the official broadcasters: Disney says the program is "the recorded ceremony." The taping starts at 7 p.m. PT. Fans who want to see it as it happens need a ticket to the Peacock Theater show; everyone else waits for the ABC broadcast, which can also be watched through live TV services that carry your local ABC station.

The Class of 2026 was announced on April 13, 2026. Performers: Phil Collins, Billy Idol, Iron Maiden, Joy Division/New Order, Oasis, Sade, Luther Vandross and Wu-Tang Clan. Early Influence Award: Celia Cruz, Fela Kuti, Queen Latifah, MC Lyte and Gram Parsons. Musical Excellence Award: songwriter Linda Creed, producer Arif Mardin, producer Jimmy Miller and producer Rick Rubin. Ahmet Ertegun Award: TV host Ed Sullivan. To be eligible, an artist must have released a first commercial recording at least 25 years before the year of nomination.

The Hall says the 2027 ceremony returns to Cleveland, where its museum is. Presenters and performers for the Nov. 14 show had not been fully announced when this page was written.
in_the_news: The 2026 induction ceremony tapes on Nov. 14 in Los Angeles; the broadcast follows in December.

faq.q: Is the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction live on TV?
faq.a: No. It is taped on Nov. 14, 2026, and airs as an edited special on ABC on Dec. 8.

faq.q: Can I stream the 2026 Rock Hall ceremony?
faq.a: Yes, on Disney+ and Hulu starting Dec. 9, 2026, the day after the ABC broadcast.

faq.q: Where is the 2026 Rock and Roll Hall of Fame ceremony?
faq.a: At the Peacock Theater in Los Angeles on Saturday, Nov. 14, 2026, at 7 p.m. PT.

faq.q: Who is being inducted into the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame in 2026?
faq.a: Performers Phil Collins, Billy Idol, Iron Maiden, Joy Division/New Order, Oasis, Sade, Luther Vandross and Wu-Tang Clan, plus Celia Cruz, Fela Kuti, Queen Latifah, MC Lyte, Gram Parsons, Linda Creed, Arif Mardin, Jimmy Miller, Rick Rubin and Ed Sullivan.

faq.q: What time does the Rock Hall special air on ABC?
faq.a: 8 to 11 p.m. ET/PT on Tuesday, Dec. 8, 2026.
